capabilities: Report external renames to Obsidian as single renames
Recognize renames made while Obsidian was closed
Handle moved files and whole folders
Offer to install Advanced Rename and Delete Handler
disambiguation: Not a file-renaming tool; it only recognizes renames made outside Obsidian and reports them.
extras: Documentation is a demo vault shipped with releases and browsable on GitHub. Renames are only recognized where the file system keeps a file's inode, and dot-files are never handled. Since 4.0.0 the plugin no longer rewrites links itself.
intentEvidence: recognizes those external renames for what they are and reports them to Obsidian as a single rename
problem: A file renamed in a file manager, script or sync client arrives in Obsidian as a delete plus a create, so every note linking to it is left pointing at nothing.

relations.evidence: Rewriting the links that pointed at the old name is then done by Advanced Rename and Delete Handler
Same goal, different detection: pairs by inode
Same goal, different detection: pairs by inode; finds offline renames by itself

summary: Detects renames made outside Obsidian and reports them as a single rename so files keep their identity and open tabs follow.
